title: 12 Geniuses (Don MacPherson) — 'The best business book I've read in 20 years'
summary: Don MacPherson releases E188 of his 12 Geniuses podcast with Eric. Announces the episode with a 29-like LinkedIn endorsement that goes further than most: 'the best business book I've read in 20 years' and 'This book will influence a generation of entrepreneurs.' Frames the book as an answer to the question 'What if human flourishing was the measure by which we evaluate organizations?'
blockquote:
"Incorruptible" is the best business book I've read in 20 years. I found this copy out in the wild at my local bookstore. This book will influence a generation of entrepreneurs. It answers the question: "What if human flourishing was the measure by which we evaluate organizations?"

I am so thrilled that I had the chance to interview the author Eric Ries for E188 of 12 Geniuses.
